# `admin.user.reset-password`

Reset a user password

Site admins only. Revokes sessions and, unless kept, scoped tokens.

- Method and path: `POST /admin/users/{user}/reset-password`
- Scope: `admin:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie admin user reset-password`
- MCP: `admin_user_reset-password`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | body | no | `string` |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `keep_tokens` | body | no | `boolean` |
| `password` | body | no | `string` |
| `random` | body | no | `boolean` |
| `user` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `not-found`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
